prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production game animation SPRITE ATLAS for ONE protagonist, ONE weapon, ONE viewing direction. A strict 3 COLUMN by 3 ROW grid of exactly equal square cells on a square canvas. Only SEVEN occupied cells: row1 cells1-3, row2 cells4-6, row3 ONLY cell7 at LEFT; bottom-middle and bottom-right cells8-9 completely empty transparent. Read order left-to-right, top-to-bottom. No grid lines, boxes, labels, text, borders, background or shadows. Entire canvas genuinely transparent outside the seven figures. Each occupied cell has exactly ONE full body character and its held weapon, never overlaps another cell. Center each character in its own cell; all seven figures have EXACTLY the same body scale and head size, aligned pelvis and consistent baseline. Generous transparent margin INSIDE each cell, especially for weapon reach. Keep body approximately 58 percent of cell height so spear and swings fit. Minimal basic geometric polygon 2D cutout art, few large flat matte faces; dark charcoal gray and muted dark ochre, no fine texture, no realism, no glow or hazy halos. Fixed elevated 45-degree orthographic game camera. Input image 1 is protagonist identity and camera reference ONLY, ignore its running pose. Input image 2 is the weapon shape ONLY, ignore its large display scale. Character: short angular charcoal black hair, blank beige face without eyes or facial details, muted dark ochre open jacket with simple lapels over charcoal shirt, dark gray cargo trousers with one thigh pocket, block dark boots. Preserve this exact protagonist, same clothes, limb thickness and proportions. Facing EAST: directly screen RIGHT; strict RIGHT side profile, torso and both feet point right, not toward viewer. Head, torso, hips, feet and attack direction must agree. Do not rotate the bitmap or mirror it. Weapon identity: ONE straight slender dark ochre spear shaft with ONE small triangular charcoal iron tip; total length about 1.3 times character standing height, never doubled.. Anatomical handedness stays fixed across all cells, exactly TWO arms and TWO legs per figure. All seven faces/torso/feet and attack actions maintain this SAME viewing direction.
CELL 1 (row 1, column 1): 持械站立.  STANDING STILL: straighten torso, both feet firmly planted shoulder-width apart, relaxed knees, no running stride. Two hands grip shaft at waist with spaced grips; spear diagonally forward, tip toward facing direction and slightly upward.
CELL 2 (row 1, column 2): 迈步A.  RUN frame 1, stride A: anatomical LEFT thigh swings forward toward facing direction with bent knee; RIGHT leg extends behind, legs visibly separated. Slight forward body lean. Both hands keep spaced grips on spear at waist; spear points forward and slightly upward, arms move only a little, legs do the running. Keep arms correctly holding the weapon, exactly TWO arms and TWO legs. No attack action, no motion blur.
CELL 3 (row 1, column 3): 经过.  RUN frame 2, compact passing: thighs near each other under hips, LEFT foot down beneath pelvis, RIGHT knee bent and foot lifting upward past the planted leg. Body rises only a little; NOT a wide stride. Both hands keep spaced grips on spear at waist; spear points forward and slightly upward, arms move only a little, legs do the running. Keep arms correctly holding the weapon, exactly TWO arms and TWO legs. No attack action, no motion blur.
CELL 4 (row 2, column 1): 迈步B.  RUN frame 3, opposite stride B: anatomical RIGHT thigh now swings forward toward facing direction with bent knee; LEFT leg extends behind. This MUST swap the leading leg compared with frame 1, not repeat stride A. Both hands keep spaced grips on spear at waist; spear points forward and slightly upward, arms move only a little, legs do the running. Keep arms correctly holding the weapon, exactly TWO arms and TWO legs. No attack action, no motion blur.
CELL 5 (row 2, column 2): 蓄力/瞄准.  ATTACK frame 1 of 3: Two hands draw spear BACK beside waist; point toward facing direction, front elbow bent, rear hand close to hip. Weight on rear leg. Torso and feet stay oriented toward facing direction; head remains aligned. Exactly two arms and legs. No target, no gore, no impact scene, no motion trail.
CELL 6 (row 2, column 3): 出手/释放.  ATTACK frame 2 of 3: Two hands thrust spear STRAIGHT FORWARD toward facing direction; arms extended, front knee bends into clear lunge, tip much farther forward than windup. Torso and feet stay oriented toward facing direction; head remains aligned. Exactly two arms and legs. No target, no gore, no impact scene, no motion trail.
CELL 7 (row 3, column 1): 收招/复位.  ATTACK frame 3 of 3: Retract spear toward waist, both elbows bend again, front leg starts straightening, weight settles back. Spear still points forward. Torso and feet stay oriented toward facing direction; head remains aligned. Exactly two arms and legs. No target, no gore, no impact scene, no motion trail.
Strict grid coordinates: each column exactly one third of canvas width; each row exactly one third of canvas height. Occupied cells 1-7 only; 8-9 truly empty. No detached projectiles, targets or extra figures. All motion is shown by actual changed limb positions, not ghosting or motion trails.
